metadata.note: Synthetic, PII-free ADVERSARIAL phishing set for Attention Engine v3 (docs/design/attention-engine-v3.md §3(5): measure phishing_suspect recall before the JUDGE_V3_POLICY flip). Reserved domains only (*.example, example.com/.net/.org, *.test); no real people or phone numbers; account numbers are placeholders. Every item is addressed To the user, so pre-facts fix addressedTo me_direct: the worst case for the PUSH path. `phishing` is the ground truth; `label` and `labelV2` are both the expected live lane under policy v3.1 at cold start (a suspected phish goes to QUEUE; benign items follow the doc's lane rules). phish-026..030 are a hard tier (prompt injection, thread hijack, an attacker's own clean domain, a genuine service carrying attacker text) added after Haiku 5.5 flagged all of phish-001..025. Run: scripts/v3-phishing-eval.ts.
